subject: mercedes-sinclair
label: Forty-four in three hours
to: ALL FORTY-FOUR MEMBERS OF THE FOUND FAMILY, over three hours, when she was adopted
note:
THE SERMON, DELIVERED IN FULL, ON DAY ONE. Mercedes Sinclair clawed her way out of shame deep enough to have texture and understood her hunger was not a wound but a sermon — and then she was taken in by forty-four women and worked through every one of them in an afternoon.

AND SHE IS STILL NOT THE BENCHMARK. DIA MAKES HER LOOK CHASTE, which is the only reason this number is on the record at all: it exists to give a scale to somebody else.

The roster stood at forty-four at the time; it is seventy-two now.
